paraphrase: Dhanya, a rich young man, became a monk and fasted with such rigour that his body is described limb by limb as withered like dry leaves and pods; Mahāvīra praised him to King Śreṇika as the greatest ascetic among his monks. He was reborn in the highest heaven.
notes: Restricted theme (prolonged fasting): the text's description only; no practice instruction.
